THE ALL-NEW
2013 SENTRA®
INTRODUCING THE MOST INNOVATIVE SENTRA EVER.
Your “someday” car is here, today. Sentra completely redefines what an affordable car can be
and proves the good life is well within reach. With tasteful styling inside and out. Advanced
available features you’ll love, including Pandora®-friendly audio and a huge interior with surprising
luxuries like Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control and Push Button Ignition. The drive’s
special too, with a super-smooth Xtronic CVT® transmission and a class-leading1 34 combined
MPG.2 You’ve arrived, and well ahead of schedule. The all-new 2013 Nissan Sentra.
Nissan. Innovation that excites.TM
